touchpoints: declared at creation: where this brand will live (web, pitch deck, print, product UI, signage...) — deliverable formats are compiled from this list

customer.$rationale: where this insight came from (interview, data, founder observation)

category_conventions: what everyone in this category does

context.longevity_evidence: why this is not a fad

theme.because_test: theme BECAUSE right_to_win — the sentence must close logically

category_entry_points: situations in which the brand must come to mind

naming.$rationale: why this name expresses the theme
naming.$excludes: name types/names deliberately avoided and why
naming.phonosemantics: sound profile vs target attributes (modest effect: record it, never decide by it)

clearance.human_legal_clearance: PENDING — the skill triages; the final opinion is a lawyer's

not_like_this.example: a sentence another brand could legitimately say

moments._note: voice is constant, tone varies by moment — audits compare against the right moment

visual.$overall_rationale: how the visual territory derives from the theme
visual.$excludes: visual territory deliberately avoided (e.g., the broken conventions)

tokens._format: W3C DTCG: $value/$type. 3 layers: primitive -> semantic -> component

palette.$excludes: hues avoided (category convention or portfolio collision)
palette.hierarchy_warning: color is the WEAKEST distinctive asset (12% fame / 39% uniqueness); reinforcement, never the main axis

typography.$rationale: why this ratio / these families express the theme

logo.type: constructible (monogram | letterform | geometric symbol) | expressive (OUT OF SCOPE — brief for external designer)

construction._note: parameterized geometric construction, never freehand drawing; SVG with declared grid and coordinates

logo.clear_space: proportional: x = [logo dimension]; minimum margin = 1x on all sides
logo.optical_adjustments: overshoot on curves/apexes; vertical nudge of centered elements — the eye is the arbiter, not pure geometry
logo.$excludes: morphologies avoided (category convention or portfolio collision)

imagery_and_icons.icon_system: shared grid, stroke coherent with the typography

discarded_routes.why_discarded: attached as justification for the single delivered route (Malinic: one big idea)

portfolio_summary._note: block copied into the portfolio registry when the brand is approved
logo_morphology: tags: geometric, monogram, angular, organic, circular-grid, ...
